title: Uruguayan-Style Crispy Skillet Steak
description: A flavorful and crispy steak dish inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, made with a skillet and a few simple ingredients.

ingredients.name: Skillet steak (1-1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with a good balance of fat and lean meat

ingredients.name: Meat seasoning
ingredients.notes: Uruguayan-style meat seasoning or a mix of paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder

instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the steak dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture.
Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Brush the steak with xtra-virgin olive oil.
Coat the steak with crispy bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Sear the steak in the skillet for 3-4 minutes per side, or until a nice crust forms.
Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve.
